点击按钮触发文件上传功能。.en-us: Click the button to upload a file.

通过参数`buttonProps`控制上传按钮相关参数，以撑满父元素为例。.en-us: Use `buttonProps` to configure the upload button, for example to fill its parent width.

通过参数`fileListMaxLength`限制上传列表中的文件上传记录最大数.en-us: Use `fileListMaxLength` to limit the number of upload records in the file list.

通过参数`fileTypes`限制可上传的文件类型。.en-us: Use `fileTypes` to restrict allowed upload file types.

设置参数`multiple=True`后可一次性上传多个文件。.en-us: Set `multiple=True` to upload multiple files at once.

设置参数`directory=True`后可选择文件夹进行内部文件的批量上传。.en-us: Set `directory=True` to select a folder and upload its files in a batch.

设置参数`failedTooltipInfo`进行上传失败文件的错误提示信息自定.en-us: Use `failedTooltipInfo` to customize upload failure messages.

设置参数`confirmBeforeDelete=True`为已上传文件记录的删.en-us: Set `confirmBeforeDelete=True` to require confirmation before deleting an uploaded file.
